cost_models.note: spread_points is consumed as PRICE units by bar_quote(bar_spread=None), exit_side_bar_range(None) and protective_level_fill_quote; raw bar spreads are MT5 points converted with point_size. Verified by probe and by case quote_default_spread_is_price_units.

bid_ask_spread_fees.hand_calculation: raw spread 60 points * point_size 0.01 = 0.60 price units; bid = close = 20000.0; ask = 20000.0 + 0.60 = 20000.60
missing raw spread falls back to the configured default spread 0.6 (price units); ask = 20000.60
a recorded zero spread is honored (not replaced by the 0.6 default): ask = bid = 20000.0

bid_ask_spread_fees.classification: documented alternative semantics (units naming): the field spread_points is used as price units when no bar spread is supplied
bid_ask_spread_fees.hand_calculation: bar_quote(close=100.0) with no bar spread: ask = 100.0 + 0.6 = 100.6 (0.6 price units, i.e. 60 points at point_size 0.01)
long market order buys at the ask: 100.5
short market order sells at the bid: 99.5
direction 0 is not a trade side: ValueError (fixed in fixture version 2.0.0; was source defect C1).

bid_ask_spread_fees.classification: documented semantics (former C2), pinned: fill_price returns the quote side and does not apply slippage_points. Slippage is applied on quote paths (tick, protective) before fill_price. Changing this would double count config slippage (5.0) on env fills; see semantic_contracts.md section 5.
bid_ask_spread_fees.hand_calculation: long pays the ask 100.5; slippage_points 0.5 is NOT added inside fill_price (it is applied on the quote paths). Pinned at 100.5 to guard against a double-count change.
commission 2.5 per lot * 4.0 lots = 10.0
no position pays no commission: 2.5 * 0.0 = 0.0
a negative fee would be a silent rebate, so construction is rejected
long stop at 99.0 with adverse slippage 0.5: bid = 99.0 - 0.5 = 98.5; ask = bid + spread 0.6 = 99.1. The sell fill is the bid, 98.5.
short stop at 101.0 with adverse slippage 0.5: ask = 101.0 + 0.5 = 101.5; bid = ask - 0.6 = 100.9. The buy fill is the ask, 101.5.
long, bar opens above the stop: trigger = min(99.0, 100.0) = 99.0; bid = 99.0; ask = 99.0 + 0.6 = 99.6
long gap: bar opens through the stop at 98.0. trigger = min(99.0, 98.0) = 98.0; the fill is the worse open, not the stop: bid 98.0
short, bar opens below the stop: opening ask = 100.0 + 0.6 = 100.6; trigger = max(101.0, 100.6) = 101.0; ask = 101.0; bid = 101.0 - 0.6 = 100.4
short gap up: opening ask = 102.0 + 0.6 = 102.6; trigger = max(101.0, 102.6) = 102.6 (worse than the stop); ask = 102.6; bid = 102.0
long stop with slippage 0.5 and no gap: trigger 99.0; bid = 98.5; ask = 99.1
opening long buys at ask: ask 100.5 + 0.5 = 101.0; bid untouched
opening short sells at bid: bid 99.5 - 0.5 = 99.0; ask untouched
closing long sells at bid: 99.5 - 0.5 = 99.0
closing short buys at ask: 100.5 + 0.5 = 101.0
negative slippage would be a favorable fill and is rejected
inverse of QF-19 on an applied quote (ask 100.5 was 101.0 before slippage): ask 100.5 - 0.5 = 100.0
long exits transact on bid, so the bar bid range is used as is
short exits transact on ask: bid range shifted by recorded spread 0.5 -> [99.5, 101.5]
no recorded spread: default 0.6 price units applied to the short ask range -> [99.6, 101.6]
a missing spread stays missing (None), it is not converted to 0

sizing_lot_rounding.hand_calculation: budget 50 USD; 50 / 100 = 0.5 lots
explicit risk 500 USD: 500 / 100 = 5.0; the fractional-sizing cap of 100 USD is ignored when risk_usd is given
uncapped 1e7 / 100 = 1e5 lots; clipped to max_lot 100.0
stop distance 5e-9 is below the 1e-8 guard: returns min_lot 0.01 instead of dividing

sizing_lot_rounding.classification: documented alternative semantics: compute_lots clips to [min_lot, max_lot] as its docstring states, so a zero risk budget still returns min_lot. Risk concern for owner review; the execution-reserve sizer returns 0 for the same case (SZ-16).
sizing_lot_rounding.hand_calculation: budget 0 -> lots 0 -> clipped up to min_lot 0.01

stop risk per lot 1.0 USD, reserve per lot 1.0 USD, all-in 2.0; stop budget 100 * 1.0 / 2.0 = 50 USD; lots_at_budget = 100 / 2.0 = 50; affordable 50; step 0.01 -> 5000 steps = 50.00 lots. Check: 50 * 2.0 = 100 <= 100.
same as SZ-09 on a 0.1 lot grid: 50.0 is 500 steps
lots_at_budget = 0.005 / 2.0 = 0.0025 < min_lot 0.01 -> no trade (0.0)
zero stop distance -> stop risk per lot 0 -> no trade (0.0)
a non-positive lot step is rejected before sizing

sizing_lot_rounding.classification: documented rule, pinned (not changed): floor(affordable/lot_step) on the float64 quotient. Hand value 0.29 is the exact decimal answer; the rule returns 0.28 because 0.29/0.01 = 28.999999999999996.
sizing_lot_rounding.hand_calculation: stop distance 10 -> stop risk 10 USD per lot; reserve 0; stop budget 2.9; lots = 2.9 / 10 = 0.29 exactly in decimal; floor(0.29 / 0.01) = 29 steps -> 0.29. Actual: 0.28 because 0.29 / 0.01 = 28.999999999999996 in float64.
adverse stop slippage 2 * 3 lots * 100 * 1.0 = 600; round-trip commission 2 * 1.5 * 3 = 9; total 609
negative lots are clamped to 0 before costing: reserve 0
swing low equal to entry is not strictly below it: invalid long structure
direction 0 is not a side: rejected before any stop is created

partial_targets.hand_calculation: final slot with a 0.2 runner: leg 0.5; runner keeps 0.2, so the 0.5 leg leaves 0.5 open (1.0 - 0.5 >= 0.2)
leg 0.5 would leave 0.1 < runner 0.2; clamp to 0.6 - 0.2 = 0.4 so the runner is kept
final slot without runner closes the whole remaining 0.15
leg share 0.3*0.01=0.003 rounds to 0.0: the leg must not close the whole 0.01 position. Fixed in version 2.0.0 (was source defect C3): returns 0.0.

partial_targets.classification: documented rule, pinned (not changed): Python round(x, 2) (round-half-even on the float64 value). 0.135 is stored as slightly above the midpoint, so it rounds to 0.14.
partial_targets.hand_calculation: leg share 0.5*0.27 = 0.135 (float64 value slightly above the midpoint); round(0.135, 2) = 0.14 under the pinned rule.

partial_targets.classification: documented rule, pinned: exact midpoint 0.125 rounds to 0.12 (round-half-even, not up).
partial_targets.hand_calculation: leg share 0.5*0.25 = 0.125 exactly representable; round-half-even to 2 decimals gives 0.12 (round-half-up would give 0.13).

rng_event_keys.hand_calculation: determinism: two generators built from the same (seed, key) produce identical bit streams
distinct event keys give distinct streams (the key is part of the SHA-256 derivation input)
distinct execution seeds give distinct streams for the same event key

rng_event_keys.classification: characterization (not hand-calculated): SHA-256 derivation cannot be done by hand. Value frozen from the implementation at fixture version 1.0.0; a change requires a new fixture version.

timing_and_sessions.hand_calculation: 2026-03-29 is the Sunday of the CET->CEST switch. Prague is UTC+1 until 01:00 UTC on 29 March. At 22:59:59 UTC on 28 March Prague time is 23:59:59 on 28 March.
Prague midnight of 29 March in CET (UTC+1) is 23:00 UTC on 28 March: the new day starts exactly here
summer time: Prague is UTC+2, so 21:59:59 UTC is 23:59:59 on 30 June
22:00 UTC in summer time is 00:00 CEST on 1 July
a naive timestamp has no known zone and is rejected (never read as broker time)

timing_and_sessions.classification: characterization of inclusive endpoints (both 16:30 and 23:00 are tradable); owner to confirm the window convention
timing_and_sessions.hand_calculation: default window 16:30 to 23:00 inclusive on clock time
window wraps midnight (start 22:00 > end 02:00): clock times 22:00 through 02:00 inclusive are in

rewards.hand_calculation: on breach the penalty -10 replaces the pnl term, even for a gain
fixed_risk_usd must be > 0 (division by zero otherwise)
equity at or below zero is a ruin breach: penalty -10.0 (log of a non-positive value is undefined)
a non-positive start equity has no log return and is rejected

defect_cases.classification: known broker-boundary limit (not a defect in the env path): Broker.open_position does not refresh equity. The env calls mark_to_market right after every open (entry_execution_runtime.py), which restores the identity. Pinned by test.
defect_cases.hand_calculation: commission 2.0 deducted: balance 9998. Equity is not refreshed by open, so it stays 10000. Mark at bid 100.0 with entry 100.6: (100.0-100.6)*1*100 = -60, so balance + open_pnl = 9998 - 60 = 9938.
